subject: Aurora Bank: operator trust brief & KMS transport verification request
messages:
From: Samantha Lewis <samantha.lewis@aurorabank.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Cc: security@aurorabank.com
Date: Thu, 29 Oct 2026 14:03:22 -0700
Subject: Request: operator trust brief + transport verification for KMS/HSM

Hi Stephanie,

Thanks for the quick onboarding call earlier. As part of Aurora's SIG intake we're documenting operational controls around customer-managed keys and the HSM interface. Two specific asks we had follow-on from the review: 

1) A short "operator trust brief" that explains how Redwood segments HSM/KMS operator roles (who can trigger rotation, who has export privileges, separation of duties), and the audit trails you capture during operator actions.

2) A transport verification snapshot showing the most recent rotation cycle for a tenant-byok key — timestamps, operator IDs, and wrapping/unwrapping steps (redacted material keys are fine). Ideally in CSV or table form.

Can you send us the brief and a csv snapshot by end of day tomorrow? If any of this needs an NDA amendment or a separate attestation, tell us and we can route it.

Appreciate it — Samantha

Samantha Lewis
Director, Information Security
Aurora Bank

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Lewis <samantha.lewis@aurorabank.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, irene_choi@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 29 Oct 2026 16:12:08 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: operator trust brief + transport verification for KMS/HSM

Samantha — thanks, we can get that over. A few clarifying points so we deliver what you need: 

- Operator trust brief: will include role separation (operator, auditor, sysadmin), RBAC mappings, emergency access procedures, and typical audit log entries (timestamps, operator principal, action).
- Rotation snapshot: we can provide a CSV with the rotation event timeline and pseudonymous operator IDs (e.g., operator-17) plus which HSM cluster performed the wrap/unwrap. We do not include raw key material.

Two quick asks from our side: can you confirm whether the snapshot needs to show external KMS wrap/unwrap calls (cloud provider logs) in addition to Redwood-side operator events? Also, please confirm the distribution channel — link to Aurora's secure Intake Drive or to the email address above.

I'll prepare a compact brief and a redacted rotation CSV. Ben and Irene are looped to pull the rotation export and HSM attestation references.

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
Head of Product Security Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 29 Oct 2026 17:08:47 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Aurora - operator trust brief + rotation snapshot (action items)

Ben/Irene — forwarding Aurora's request. Action items: 

- Ben: please export the tenant BYOK rotation timeline for tenant aurora-prod-1 for the last rotation (2026-10-25). CSV should include: event_id, event_time (ISO), operator_id (pseudonymize), action_type (generate/rotate/wrap/unwrap), hsm_cluster_id, operation_result. Redact key material.

- Irene: please pull the HSM attestation reference docs and any available sealed log extracts for that cycle (we can provide attestation reference numbers and HSM vendor quote). Put both items in the secure Drive folder and mark as "Aurora Intake - OP TRUST".

If either of you think we need a short attestation letter (signed by Security) vs. the standard artifact delivery, flag me. Target: drop artifacts and the brief into the Drive by tomorrow EOD PST.

—Stephanie

Subject: RE: Request: operator trust brief + transport verification for KMS/HSM — artifacts attached to Drive

Samantha / Aurora team — attaching the operator trust brief and a redacted rotation snapshot to the secure Drive link below. We also included HSM attestation references for the cluster that handled the rotation event. Quick notes below and attachments: 

Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2B3C-optrust

Attachments (in folder):
- op-trust-brief.pdf (short explainer on operator roles, separation of duties, RBAC mappings, emergency breakglass, and log retention windows)
- kms-rotation-snapshot.csv (rotation timeline, pseudonymized operator IDs, wrap/unwrap step markers)
- hsm-attestation-refs.txt (HSM vendor attestation IDs and timestamped seals)

Highlights / answers to your earlier clarifying questions: 
- The rotation snapshot includes Redwood-side operator events and the HSM cluster response. We do not include cloud provider wrap logs unless you request them; we can pull them on a separate authorized request.
- Operator IDs are pseudonymized (operator-01, operator-17) and map to staff in our internal roster; we can provide full mapping under an approved NDA or with your internal data sharing agreement.
- Audit logs include immutability proofs (sealed log hashes) and the brief explains how we verify log integrity across the rotation lifecycle.

If you need a signed attestation letter (one-paragraph) confirming the artifact redaction and authenticity, we can have Security sign and deliver by Monday.

Thanks — let us know if anything else is required for the SIG intake.

Best regards,
Stephanie Nguyen
Head of Product Security Operations
Redwood Inference
